findings.issue: `SheafOfModules.stalkMap` is the functorial stalk map of an arbitrary morphism of sheaves of modules — no tensor-product content — kept `private` here; it duplicates the private `PresheafOfModules.sheafificationStalkMap` in `Sheaf/Stalk.lean:71`. Because it is private, `tensorStalkComparison` has no public `_def`/composite lemma, so a consumer with an arbitrary germ of `(tensorProduct R M N).val.presheaf` cannot reach the sheafification stalk (`sheafificationStalkEquiv` is stated for `(sheafification …).obj (M.val ⊗ N.val)`), blocking the injectivity half of the next roadmap step.

findings.issue: `germSemilinear` — the germ map of an arbitrary presheaf of modules as a semilinear map over the ring germ hom — is general infrastructure hidden as `private` in a tensor-product file. Its statement mentions only Mathlib types and its proof has no tensor dependency.

summary: Two general-infrastructure declarations are hidden as `private` in this tensor-product file: the semilinear germ map and the stalk map of a morphism of sheaves of modules. The latter also leaves `tensorStalkComparison` without any public way to compute on an arbitrary germ.
